title: New Year's Evil Body Doubles #1 DC 1998 One-Shot Resurrection Man Abnett Lanning
condition_description: Light wear on the black cover with small edge chips at the top left; back cover lightly soiled. See photos.
description:
New Year's Evil: Body Doubles #1 (February 1998), DC Comics one-shot - from the pages of Resurrection Man. Written by Dan Abnett and Andy Lanning, art by Joe Phillips and Joe Rodriguez. Direct sales, $1.95 cover price.

Back cover: Gap Athletic hooded sweatshirt ad.

Condition: light wear on the black cover with small edge chips at the top left; back cover lightly soiled (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
